name: library-management-system
description: Complete Library Management System with AI features

scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend && pip install -r ai-service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend
